subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should the permanent SessionCatalogProvider API keep upstream source identity and transcript classification opaque and plugin-owned, or intentionally publish the current Claude/Codex-specific contract from core?
rationale: This changes the public Plugin SDK and owner boundary; code review can identify the coupling, but only maintainers can choose the permanent extension contract.

options.title: Use an opaque plugin contract
options.body: Make source identity and classification provider-owned while core stores opaque JSON and records generic activity descriptors.

options.title: Publish the closed bundled contract
options.body: Keep the Claude/Codex union and core classifier exports as an intentionally limited public API with explicit compatibility ownership.

recommendation.title: Use an opaque plugin contract
recommendation.body: Make source identity and classification provider-owned while core stores opaque JSON and records generic activity descriptors.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-state and watcher history plus the current catalog work make this the closest available decision owner.
